thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service embedder-api-canary :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Alert: 5xx-rate > 10% for 5m on embedder-api-canary (route: /v1/embed). Severity: P1. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345
pagerduty: Escalation: paging Jamal (SRE) -> primary oncall rotation.
Jamal (SRE): looking into it, grabbing logs and kube details. oncall-ingress.
Marta (PM): Noted - any customer-visible errors yet? any key customers hit?
Priya (support): we have two open CS tickets reporting timeouts from a major partner region, tied to 500s. ticket ids: CS-9182, CS-9184.
Ken (eng-oncall): can you confirm which commit rolled? I see a canary roll at 12:03 UTC (sha: a1b2c3d).
Ava (infra): rollout started at 12:00, traffic split 10% canary -> 90% stable. Canary replicas: 3 on g4dn.
Jamal (SRE): reproducing locally against canary: I see a stacktrace path: embedder.handler -> encoder.transform where we hit OOM-ish memory pressure and then 500. pasting snippet:
```
2026-03-14T12:07:11Z ERROR encoder - OOM killing request id=abcd1234 mem=6.1G limit=6G
2026-03-14T12:07:12Z INFO kubelet - container restart embedder-api-canary-xyz
```
Ken (eng-oncall): interesting, autoscaler didn't spin more up. Was resource request changed in the canary image?
Marta (PM): traffic fraction is only 10% but partner SREs report widespread failures, so maybe a downstream fanout causing amplification.
Jamal (SRE): immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce canary traffic to 0% via rollout-control 2) scale canary replicas to 6 3) roll back to previous canary image sha. which do we prefer?
Priya (support): recommendation from CS: rollback. partner SLAs red, want quick surface.
Ken (eng-oncall): rolling rollback now to previous release (sha: z9y8x7w). executing kubectl rollout undo on deployment/embedder-api-canary in cluster-prod-canary.
Ken (eng-oncall): runbook command:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embedder-api-canary --to-revision=3
kubectl -n prod patch svc embedder-api --patch '{"spec":{"traffic":{"canary":0}}}'
```
Ava (infra): done patching traffic to 0% canary; confirmed 100% stable routing.
Ken (eng-oncall): rollback initiated, pods terminating and recreating. Watching readiness and 5xx rate.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: INC12345 updated - status: mitigation_in_progress.
Jamal (SRE): after rollback, 5xx rate dropped under threshold within two minutes. metrics: 5xx-rate 12:07 -> 2.1% at 12:10.
Marta (PM): marking customer impact: partner region saw 7 minutes of errors, CS escalated. Prioritize root-cause RCA: candidate is a model quantization path change in a1b2c3d.
Priya (support): notified partners, they confirmed degraded requests are back to normal. sending official incident note.
Jamal (SRE): next steps: gather core dumps, cpu/mem profiles from failing pods, compare envoy logs from canary vs stable. Assigning Ken and Ava to collect infra traces.
Ken (eng-oncall): collecting traces now; uploading to s3://redwood-incident/INC12345/trace.tar.gz
Ava (infra): enabling extended retention for this window, snapshots preserved.
Marta (PM): doing customer comms draft, will share.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 auto-escalation timer stopped. Incident status: mitigated.
Jamal (SRE): I'm going to leave this in 'incident' state for RCA. Will open postmortem and link to incident ticket. Thanks all for quick ops. :thumbsup:
